reference: Independent blind corpus for maintenance-test-interval-change (model 2026-10-09.mi-3), written from SPEC rev 2026-10-17.4 alone; expected values from a decimal/double reference implementation and re-derived by quadrature, direct optimisation and exact rational least squares (verify.py).
reference_citations: IEC 61508-6:2010, Annex B (B.3.2.2: simplified PFDavg equations, 1oo1 and 1oo2 with beta factor; 1oo2 MRT terms t_CE = T/2 + MRT, t_GE = T/3 + MRT, beta*lambda*(T/2 + MRT))
ISA-TR84.00.02-2015 / SINTEF PDS Method Handbook 2013 (partial proof-test coverage)
Rausand M., Hoyland A., System Reliability Theory, 2nd ed., Wiley 2004, ch. 10 (PFD as time average of unavailability)
Barlow R.E., Hunter L.C., Optimum preventive maintenance policies, Operations Research 8 (1960) 90-100
Lawless J.F., Statistical Models and Methods for Lifetime Data, 2nd ed., Wiley 2003 (Weibull censored MLE; ball-bearing data of Lieblein & Zelen 1956)
Meeker W.Q., Escobar L.A., Statistical Methods for Reliability Data, Wiley 1998, ch. 8
API 510 (10th ed. 2014) for pressure vessels, 7.1.1.1 and 6.5: long-term and short-term corrosion rates, remaining life and the half-life inspection interval
API 570 (4th ed. 2016) for piping, 7.1.1 and 6.3: the same rates, remaining life and half-life interval for piping circuits
Student t distribution one-sided 0.95 quantiles (recomputed with mpmath in verify.py)

tolerance.rule: numbers a vs e pass when |a - e| <= 1e-9*|e| (e = 0 requires a = 0); objects compared over the expected keys, arrays element by element with equal length, everything else exactly (SPEC 10)

not_benchmarked: decision_fingerprint hash value (only 'approve: true' = fingerprint of the case's own inputs)
restored_values warning: cases with restore_replaces=true omit 'warnings'
exact equality pfd_proposed == pfd_target and rate_proposed == cost_rate_limit (no exact double value exists; cases 1e-6 either side instead)
far_from_optimum exactly at 1.1 x optimum_rate and peak exactly at target
pfd_increase with a ratio within 1e-12 of 1 + 1e-9 (cases sit 5e-10 either side)
point_rate_governs when r_g and r95 are mathematically equal and nonzero, except with binary-exact data where every route gives the same double
rbi histories whose residuals sit at rounding level (RSS <= 1e-10 * Syy) without being binary-exact: se_slope is ill-conditioned in double
remainder rule r <= 1e-9*T: its numerical effect is below the 1e-9 tolerance; one case per side checks the result only
1oo2 with lambda*T below about 1e-3 (literal closed form loses more than 1e-10 to cancellation)
shape k in (1, 1.1): optimum age grows without bound as k -> 1 and root conditioning degrades
non-string list texts other than null and integers (arrays, objects, non-integer floats)
number texts producing overflow (1e400) and non-finite values
restored_values ordering, item and synthetic (not used in the calculation)
IEC 61508-6 simplified formulas: compared in METHOD-CHECK.md only
